summary: Vista Energy filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the period ended March 31, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic report of a foreign private issuer, disclosing financial results and forward-looking statements, with no event triggering a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change is reported. This is a standard quarterly financial update with no corporate event requiring special-situations classification.
